'Unless citizens control political power – national, regional and municipal – it will not be possible to control damage to the environment.'

- Pope Francis, #LaudatoSi

#climatecrisis #climatechange

Grateful to @VanJones68 & others who remind us just how much bottom-up, grassroots work has gone into radical shifts in terms of #DemDebate. From Dreamers to climate activists to criminal justice reform to #BlackLivesMatter, organizing for justice has made huge impact. Thank you.
